attr.title: Star Fox Enhanced
attr.desc: Native C++/SDL3 port of the UltraStarFox Star Fox/Starwing romhack decompilation, with Original and Star Fox EX experiences, high-frame-rate presentation and widescreen support. Requires your own legally obtained retail ROM; none is bundled.
attr.inst: Copy your own supported, unmodified Star Fox (USA)/Starwing (Europe/Germany) ROM to StarFoxEnhanced/roms/sf.sfc before first launch. The game reconstructs its runtime assets from that ROM on first boot.
